structurePlan.overview: Brick-built chibi “Jedi in white” figure inspired by the reference: a small character with blond hair, white outfit with a belt, and a blue lightsaber held in front. Built as a sturdy display model using mostly white/light-bluish-gray with tan/black/red accents and trans-clear elements for the blade.

subassemblies.name: Feet + Lower Legs (2-block-wide stance)
subassemblies.description: Two chunky white feet with short lower legs, with small tan/dark-tan accents to hint at the printed leg details. Build as a stable rectangular base for the character.
subassemblies.image_location: Bottom of the image (the two white legs/feet).

subassemblies.name: Hips + Upper Legs (blocky minifig shorts shape)
subassemblies.description: A wider hip block that transitions into the two legs. Use white plates/bricks; add subtle tan/dark-tan striping on the front/sides if possible with available colors.
subassemblies.image_location: Lower middle (upper legs/hip area above the feet).

subassemblies.name: Torso Core (white tunic)
subassemblies.description: Main body as a 4x3-ish brick core in white, with a slight front panel look (layered plates/tiles). Keep it mostly white to match the robe.

subassemblies.name: Belt + Front Pouch Detail
subassemblies.description: A contrasting belt band around the torso using dark red/red/brown and a small centered ‘pouch’ block on the front. This is a visual focal line separating torso and legs.
subassemblies.image_location: Across the waist in the middle (brown/red belt area).

subassemblies.name: Shoulders + Arms (posed to hold saber)
subassemblies.description: Two arms built as slim white subassemblies attached at the torso sides, angled inward. Use small hinge/clip-like geometry where possible with plates and small elements to create the “hands together” pose.
subassemblies.image_location: Middle-right/center (both arms bent inward, hands near the saber hilt).

subassemblies.name: Hands/Grip Block (2-handed hold)
subassemblies.description: A small tan/light-nougat grip cluster between the arms that the hilt plugs into. Prioritize strength: pin the hilt into the grip block rather than relying on a single stud connection.
subassemblies.image_location: Center-right (where the hands meet around the saber).

subassemblies.name: Head (face block)
subassemblies.description: A compact tan/light-nougat cube with a simple ‘face’ suggestion using minimal black tiles/plates/studs for eyes/eyebrows and a tiny mouth line. Keep it readable from the front.

subassemblies.name: Hair (blond swoop)
subassemblies.description: Layered yellow plates/tiles/slopes to form a swept, slightly shaggy hair cap. Build it as a removable top module that sits on the head.

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber Hilt
subassemblies.description: Cylindrical-looking hilt using light-bluish-gray/dark-bluish-gray and flat-silver/gray accents (stacked round-like approximations with small plates). Designed to plug securely into the grip block.

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber Blade
subassemblies.description: A straight blue blade using trans-clear elements with blue/azure pieces as accents, forming a rigid “beam” extending upward. Keep it simple and straight for durability.
subassemblies.image_location: Upper-right (bright blue blade extending diagonally upward).

notes: Color-matching: use mostly White for clothing; Light Bluish Gray/Dark Bluish Gray for the hilt; Yellow for hair; Tan/Medium Nougat for face/hands; Dark Red/Red/Reddish Brown for the belt.
Scale: aim for ~10–14 bricks tall total (feet to hair) for a recognizable, sturdy chibi figure.
Posing: lock the arms into the torso with plates/overlaps so the 2-handed saber pose doesn’t droop.
If you’re short on suitable small face detailing parts, prioritize the hair silhouette and belt line—those sell the character fastest.
Blade strength: build the blade as a layered plate/brick beam (not a single-stud stack) to avoid wobble.
